retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic roadside composition featuring a close-up partial portrait in the foreground balanced by a deep vanishing point road and a distant figure.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-layered composition: a cropped male portrait in a white cowboy hat on the right, an electric guitar lying on the asphalt in the center-foreground, and a distant figure walking away down a long desert highway toward a clear blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Right-aligned facial crop balancing left-aligned text
Central vertical axis formed by road markings and distant figure
Contrast between textured asphalt and smooth sky
coreInvariants: Long asphalt road with yellow center line
Clear blue sky with soft horizon haze

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is a large-scale partial face on the right; secondary subject is a small figure at the vanishing point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white cowboy hat provides the brightest high-contrast anchor point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, follows the guitar up the road to the distant figure, then moves to the text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of open sky and asphalt provide breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blues in the sky and guitar body
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns in the shirt and desert landscape
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow road line and white hat
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the sky and hat; medium saturation in the landscape; high contrast on the foreground face.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses ultra-wide, heavy-weight geometric capitals
Secondary text uses a fluid, casual script
Subtitle uses a modern, square-proportioned sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Chrome-like metallic gradients on main capitals
Drop shadows to separate text from textured asphalt
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, wide architectural capitals and organic, slanted script.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, square, modern feel of the display text.
Approximates the casual, energetic feel of the secondary script.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle desert highway scene. On the right, a close-up of a man's face wearing a white cowboy hat, cropped so only half the face is visible. In the center foreground, an electric guitar lies flat on the asphalt. A long road stretches to a vanishing point where a small figure walks away. Clear blue sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply wide-tracked, metallic-beveled sans-serif text at the bottom. Add a slanted white script name above the main title on the left side.

verificationChecks: Is the cowboy hat bright white?
Does the road have a clear vanishing point?
Is the text at the bottom ultra-wide?
Is the guitar placed on the road surface?

adjustableVariables: Time of day (golden hour vs midday)
Intensity of the metallic text effect
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the foreground face
Clear atmospheric perspective in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for proper perspective of the road lines
Ensure the chrome effect on text looks reflective
Verify the hat crop doesn't look accidental
Confirm the guitar scale matches the road texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Close-up Portrait with Hat] + [Vanishing Point Road] + [Foreground Object on Ground] + [Wide Metallic Typography].
